CLIP (with atom IDs): E04.014 | 00:33.00-00:38.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Selene's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E04.015 | 00:33.20-00:38.00 | ACT | Selene grabs the Mayor by the wrist.
E04.016 | 00:33.40-00:36.44 | DLG | SELENE (shrill, sweet) | "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
E04.017 | 00:38.00-00:43.00 | CAM | Close-up on Selene's hands gripping the rail.
E04.018 | 00:38.20-00:43.00 | ACT | Selene throws open the shutters; the storm floods in.
E04.019 | 00:38.40-00:41.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, furious) | "You were always too soft for this family."
E04.020 | 00:43.00-00:46.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Tobin as the lamp flickers behind them.
E04.021 | 00:43.40-00:45.80 | DLG | MARA (hopeful, broken) | "My father built this tower with his own hands."
E04.022 | 00:46.00-00:51.00 | CAM | Close-up on Mara's jaw tightening.
E04.023 | 00:46.40-00:47.92 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (cold, furious) | "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
E04.024 | 00:51.00-00:52.00 | CAM | Close-up on Mara's jaw tightening.
E04.025 | 00:52.00-00:55.00 | CAM | Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.
E04.026 | 00:52.40-00:54.30 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (triumphant, cold) | "Lord Ashvale? That is impossible."
E04.027 | 00:55.00-00:58.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Tobin's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E04.028 | 00:55.40-00:57.80 | DLG | SELENE (cruel, sweet) | "He is lying. Everyone knows he is lying!"
E04.029 | 00:58.00-01:02.00 | CAM | Close-up on Corin's hands gripping the rail.
E04.030 | 00:58.40-01:01.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E04.031 | 01:02.00-01:07.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on the widow as the lamp flickers behind them.
E04.032 | 01:02.20-01:07.00 | ACT | the widow throws open the shutters; the storm floods in.
E04.033 | 01:07.00-01:11.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of Corin and Tobin, the space between them charged.
E04.034 | 01:11.00-01:14.00 | CAM | Over-the-shoulder shot from Tobin toward Selene.
E04.035 | 01:11.40-01:13.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (kind, afraid) | "They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!"
E04.036 | 01:14.00-01:18.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Selene as the lamp flickers behind them.
E04.037 | 01:14.40-01:17.44 | DLG | CORIN (protective, calm) | "I was drowned once. It did not take."
E04.038 | 01:18.00-01:21.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Mara as the lamp flickers behind them.
E04.039 | 01:19.50-01:21.00 | SFX | The crowd gasps.
E04.040 | 01:21.00-01:25.00 | CAM | Slow push-in on Mara as the lamp flickers behind them.
E04.041 | 01:21.40-01:24.80 | DLG | CORIN (dry, cold) | "The tide remembers every lie told on this quay."
E04.042 | 01:25.00-01:30.00 | CAM | Close-up on Tobin's hands gripping the rail.
E04.043 | 01:25.40-01:28.06 | DLG | SELENE (shrill, cruel) | "Search her pockets. She is a thief!"
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
